BAKED TURKEY MEATBALLS
Yield: 24 meatballs, 6 servings

INGREDIENTS
2 lb. 99% lean ground turkey
2 large eggs
3/4 cup panko bread crumbs
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
2 garlic cloves, minced
1/4 c. chopped fresh parsley
1 tsp. salt
1/2 tsp. pepper
1 jar (24 oz.) marinara sauce

DIRECTIONS
1. Heat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
2. Combine the ground turkey, eggs, panko, Parmesan, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper.
3. Shape into 24 meatballs and bake 18 to 20 minutes.
4. Simmer the meatballs in the marinara sauce for 10 minutes.
